description: Unofficial Bruce fan-art animated companion inspired by the green Neopets catalogue form. Nine original states feature bow straightening, a soft card display and recovery, a brief foot-powered balancing scoot, waddling in three directions and a small hop. Rounded webbed-foot and flipper shapes are simplified for sprite readability; this is original fan choreography rather than an official Neopets animation.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
